set.body:
Objective:
Complete the defining ntab workflow by reducing exact-support neuroimaging features over Frame group selections while preserving contributor identity, missingness decisions, and drill-down.

Scope:
- Frame evaluates scalar filters, group keys, row selections, ordering, and joins.
- ntab resolves selected feature references and compiles one GroupIndex or equivalent selection map for support-aware reducers.
- Initial reducers: sum, mean, variance, standard deviation, and standard error over dense volume, sparse/ROI, surface, and parcel payloads.
- Missing feature policy is Error, Drop, or Propagate. Effective counts and undefined-statistic decisions are explicit.
- Reducers validate exact support before hot loops, allocate result buffers once, and reuse owning-module construction.
- Derived rows retain stable Frame identities plus non-empty ordered contributor lineage and derivation receipts.
- drill returns the contributing root Frame selection without encoding lineage as a magic user column.

Acceptance:
- Independent scalar-loop fixtures establish every reducer at each support element.
- Group membership partitions selected rows exactly once; row permutation within a group changes results only within declared floating tolerance.
- Support mismatch fails before shared numerical loops or result allocation.
- Summary Frame schemas, typed group keys, feature handles, and runtime output schemas agree.
- Drop policy records effective contributor counts; empty and insufficient groups are typed outcomes.
- Concatenated source Frames retain original table and row identities through summaries and drill-down.
- JVM and Scala.js pass end-to-end filter, group, resolve, reduce, inspect receipt, and drill scenarios.
set.title: ntab 2: exact-support grouped reductions, contributor lineage, and drill-down
